scripts.build: npm run build-css && npm run build-js
scripts.build-css: npm run create-folders && sass --load-path=node_modules assets/scss/bootstrap.scss public/_assets/bootstrap/bootstrap.css --quiet-deps --style compressed
scripts.build-js: npm run build-js-bootstrap && npm run build-js-highlighting && npm run build-js-site
scripts.build-js-bootstrap: npm run create-folders && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/* public/_assets/bootstrap/
scripts.build-js-site: npm run create-folders && cp assets/js/*.js public/_assets/fluidtypo3org/
